# 0.1.3 — setup ci YAML, local deploy, tutorial, and optional SDKs

11 September 2026. Patch on the public **0.1.2** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.1.3
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- `opentide setup ci` emits parseable GitHub, GitLab, and Azure YAML ([#163](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/163)).
- `opentide deploy` and `validate query` no longer crash locally when `DEPLOYMENT_PLAN` is unset. Unset env defaults to `FULL` ([#164](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/164)).
- Tutorial objects validate and lint; generated templates include dates; `generate docs` writes under the detection repo ([#165](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/165)).
- `opentide info` reports `can_deploy: true` after a base `pip install`. Azure and pandas extras are not required for dry-run or platform loading ([#166](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/166)).

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup ci --flavor github --print | python -c "import sys,yaml; yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin)"
opentide info --json
opentide deploy --platform sentinel --dry-run --plan FULL --wide --skip-promotion
```

Expect `0.1.3`. `info` lists Sentinel (and the other bundled platforms) with `can_deploy: true`. CrowdStrike and HarfangLab still report `can_validate: false` by design.
